# V C M V & Associates LLP

> V C M V & Associates LLP is a multidisciplinary Chartered Accountants firm based in Chennai, India. We provide specialist services in Direct Tax, International Tax, Transfer Pricing, GST & Indirect Tax, Taxation of Expatriates, Assurance & Audit, Tax Litigation, Business Valuation, Mergers & Acquisitions, India Entry Strategies, and Business Advisory.

Our partners — Monish Gupta D (FCA), Vinay Kumar Jain (FCA), and Rakesh Kumar (ACA) — bring over 12 years each of focused expertise from Big4 and established CA practices in Chennai.

Office: Willingdon Crescent, 4th Floor, No. 6/2, Dr. S.S. Badrinath Road, Thousand Lights West, Nungambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu – 600 006, India.
Phone: +91 99628 69428
Email: monish@vcmv.in
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST

## Services

- [Direct Tax Advisory](https://vcmv.in/services/direct-tax): Corporate tax planning, transaction advisory, withholding compliance and return filing.
- [International Tax](https://vcmv.in/services/international-tax): Cross-border tax structuring for businesses entering India or expanding globally.
- [Transfer Pricing](https://vcmv.in/services/transfer-pricing): End-to-end TP compliance, benchmarking, documentation and controversy management.
- [GST & Indirect Tax](https://vcmv.in/services/gst-indirect-tax): Advisory, compliance, refunds and litigation across GST and customs.
- [Taxation of Expatriates](https://vcmv.in/services/expatriates): Tax and regulatory support for expatriates and international employee assignments.
- [Assurance & Audit](https://vcmv.in/services/assurance): Statutory, tax, internal and forensic audit services.
- [Inventory Audit](https://vcmv.in/services/inventory-audit): Physical stock verification, reconciliation, valuation review and shrinkage analysis.
- [Tax Litigation](https://vcmv.in/services/litigation): Representation across income tax, GST, customs and appellate forums.
- [Business Valuation](https://vcmv.in/services/valuation): Independent valuation for transactions, regulatory and reporting purposes.
- [Mergers & Acquisitions](https://vcmv.in/services/mergers-acquisitions): Deal advisory, due diligence, valuation and transaction support.
- [India Entry Strategies](https://vcmv.in/services/india-entry): Structural, tax and regulatory guidance for foreign businesses entering India.
- [Business & Investment Advisory](https://vcmv.in/services/advisory): Strategic guidance for growth, restructuring and capital allocation.

## Team

- [Monish Gupta D](https://vcmv.in/team/monish-gupta-d): Partner, GST & Assurance. Fellow Member (FCA), ICAI. 12+ years experience.
- [Vinay Kumar Jain](https://vcmv.in/team/vinay-kumar-jain): Partner, Income Tax & Investment Advisory. Fellow Member (FCA), ICAI. FAFD & CCAB certified. 12+ years experience.
- [Rakesh Kumar](https://vcmv.in/team/rakesh-kumar): Partner, Audit & Forensic Advisory. Associate Member (ACA), ICAI. Experience at Royal Enfield and R.G.N Price & Co.
